tools.name: consult_brain
tools.description: Get the playbook module that answers a key account management question (plan, churn risk, renewal or rate rise, meeting prep, stakeholders, portfolio health, tricky situations, email templates). Returns the module plus the rules the agent must follow.

tools.name: list_modules
tools.description: List the playbook modules with a one-line description of each.

tools.name: get_module
tools.description: Return the full text of one playbook module.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: consult_brain · Public sink: consult_brain.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: consult_brain · Public sink: consult_brain

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
